name: windirstat-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Windows Disk Analyzer, Tiering, and Safe Cleanup

scripts.docker:run: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const cwd = process.cwd(); const result = spawnSync('docker', ['run', '-i', '--name', 'windirstat-mcp-server', '-v', `${cwd}:/app`, '-v', 'C:/:/host-c:ro', 'windirstat-mcp'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.docker:clean: docker rm -f windirstat-mcp-server 2>/dev/null || true && docker rmi windirstat-mcp 2>/dev/null || true

author: Antigravity AI
